title: SOFTWARE ENGINEERING I
description: Introduction to the "front end" of the software engineering lifecycle; requirements analysis and specification; design techniques; project management.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CS 261 or 261H.
A minimum grade of C is required in CS 261 and CS 261H.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Elect & Computer Engineering (039), Computer Science (307) or Computational Engineering (A001).

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
meeting_html: TR 4pm-5:50pm in WNGR 116 - Weniger Hall 116 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
